headline: Traffic control plan for Washington and Main Streets CSO project, plus Cherry Ln. and Parkview Court parking.
summary: A traffic control plan for the Washington & Main Streets CSO project is on the agenda. Removing on-street parking on Cherry Ln. and a request for on-street parking on Parkview Court are also listed.
